Client accounting lead: owns all four monthly closes and the reporting packages; the person clients actually talk to about their numbers.

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Margin clarification needed before Thursday

Gabe, Victor –

Ahead of Thursday's board discussion, I need the gross margin figure for Q3 explained in plain terms. Specifically, the 41.2% we reported versus the 43.8% from Q2 – what drove the drop? I have my own numbers on COGS and pricing, but I want your read before I put this in front of the board.

Please send a short note (bullet points are fine) with the key drivers by Wednesday end of day. If you have a supporting schedule, attach it – I’ll pull what I need from that.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Q3 gross margin drivers – brief note

Hi Dana,

Here’s the quick read on the Q3 gross margin drop from 43.8% to 41.2%:

• Mix shift – we had a higher proportion of lower-margin product lines in Q3 vs. Q2.
• Freight costs – spot rates ran higher than the prior quarter, adding about 0.7 points.
• Pricing – a couple of large customer renewals came with modest concessions; net impact roughly 0.5 points.
• One-time write-off – a small inventory adjustment (about $18k) hit COGS in Q3; that accounts for the remainder.

I’ve got a supporting schedule with the line-by-line breakdown if you’d like it – happy to send over. Just say the word.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Re: Q3 gross margin drivers – need supporting schedule

Gabe, Victor –

Thanks for the quick note, Gabe. That covers the high level, but I need the numbers to back it up before I put this in front of the board on Thursday.

Please send the supporting schedule with the line-by-line breakdown – the one you mentioned. I want to see how the mix shift breaks down by product line, and I need the freight and pricing impacts quantified precisely, not just in points. Also, make sure the inventory write-off is clearly separated so it doesn't get conflated with ongoing operational drivers.

Send it by Wednesday end of day at the latest. If Victor has anything to add on the pricing side, I'd appreciate his confirmation on the renewal concessions.

Thanks,
Dana
